Special lunch
Sep 2026 • Family
I was here for lunch with my mother on Thursday, September 17; I had made a reservation because I really didn't want to miss the chance to eat at this restaurant. Expectations were amply rewarded: intimate and relaxed atmosphere far from the chaos of the souk, excellent and well-presented food, kind service. A special mention for the coffee and the gourmet tea with typical sweets; that tray deserved a photo. If I happen to be in Tunis again, I will not fail to visit it.

Very disappointing: Endless service and insufficient portions
Jan 2026 • Family
Used to luxury places, I am extremely disappointed by my experience at Café El Ali for breakfast.
Despite the reputation of the establishment and its magnificent setting in the Medina, the service is absolutely no longer up to standard. We had to wait an unreasonable amount of time before being served, to the point that many customers around us ended up leaving the premises for lack of patience.
Regarding the meal, the dishes are absolutely not generous and lack quality. For a restaurant of this class, one would expect a generous and refined experience, but it was quite the reverse. This is, to date, the worst breakfast I have had the opportunity to make in Tunis.
The setting is no longer enough to compensate for such a deficiency in service and cooking. I would not recommend this place until a serious remedy is made.

I aaked for a plate of pasta for my daughter which seemed to be a big ask, so left that and ordered pasta witb chicken, the chicken was tastless and still bloody. The pasta was overcooked and tastless. When I told the lady that the food was a miss, her comment was I dont understand and I can not find the words as it is the same as usual. She took it back and spoke to the chef whom you can heat swearing in the kitchen! She has been fair not to invoice for that meal though therefore the 2 stars. A real shame it used to be one of the best restaurants food and service wise.
